description.value:
A hand mirror of black volcanic glass, ground so fine it shows what's underneath a thing instead of what's in front of it. Uncomfortable to look into. More uncomfortable for whatever's looking back at you through someone else's face.

SIGNATURE — for 1 minute you automatically perceive one Named creature's true form and true location — no check, through disguise, invisibility, or possession; once during that minute you can spend the casting to deliver another Break the Anchor effect you already have at 60 feet instead of its normal melee or emanation range.
